summary: Examples of with_lines over cat /etc/motd, quoting a file name, and running a command per output line.
questions: How do I run a command for each line of another command's output?
What's an example of with_lines with quote?

answer_card.title: with_lines examples
answer_card.answer_md:
```yaml
- ansible.builtin.debug: msg="{{ item }} is a line from /etc/motd"
  with_lines: cat /etc/motd

- ansible.builtin.debug: msg="{{ item }}"
  with_lines: "cat {{ file_name | quote }}"

- ansible.builtin.shell: "/usr/bin/frobnicate {{ item }}"
  with_lines:
    - "/usr/bin/frobnications_per_host --param {{ inventory_hostname }}"
```
